video_title: Kevin Garnett | Finding Basketball, Coming Up in Chicago, Hooping with MICHAEL JORDAN 🤯

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett on establishing himself as a young superstar
quotes.excerpt: He was just coming into himself and being a young superstar
quotes.quote: When I mean established, meaning that we have won things. We have been to a Western Conference Finals, I have been to one. We have had some awards, been in countless All-Star games. He was just coming into himself and being a young superstar, and I know he cared about first team, second team, third team. I know he cared about All-Star and all that stuff. He cared about that stuff. And being honest, I am 32 at this time. I do not care about none of this.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett on his maturity and focus on team goals
quotes.excerpt: I was just an older, more mature and had more things to establish
quotes.quote: I was just an older, more mature and had more things to establish that some of the things that he cared about wasn't on my radar. So, I knew that they were important to him. So, him being the leading scorer on the team, I knew he cared about that. Him taking the last shot, I knew he cared about that. So, those things, if I had to, and he wanted me to, I could. But I am not going to fight over a shot.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett on prioritizing team success over individual stats
quotes.excerpt: I understood the marathon. I was not going to let some petty stuff
quotes.quote: I understood the marathon. I was not going to let some petty stuff that can be fixed between players and guys come in between. So, I attacked the cadence right away. I let him know, hey man, this is your team. This is your team, bro. Because I understood the marathon. I was not going to let some petty stuff that can be fixed between players and guys come in between.

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Allen asks if individual awards matter more than championships
quotes.excerpt: Does it mean the most to you to have the MVP over the championship?
quotes.quote: You got both awards, well team award and individual award. I want to know, does it mean the most to you to have the MVP over the championship? Or would you rather just have the championship and not the MVP? Which one would you have to prefer if Kevin Garnett wasn't fortunate enough to get to?

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett on the value of team success and legacy
quotes.excerpt: When you get that Larry O'Brien, you are in the guys. Y'all came together for one goal
quotes.quote: Your patches and your stripes too make you up, who you are is what they are going to remember you by. When you get them awards and them all-star and shit, those are what you have earned in the thing. When you get that Larry O'Brien, you are in the guys. Y'all came together for one goal and got this. And I know one person did any of this. Coaches went into this, equipment manager, everybody went into the Larry O'Brien. When you get that one joint, yeah you need teammates to get it there. You got to put in the basket. You got to perform. You got to be that consistently. But them stripes and what you get, bro, them the stripes, them the patches.

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Allen on Kevin Garnett's work ethic and preparation
quotes.excerpt: I dove into just the preparation and how you came in the locker room
quotes.quote: I thought that was a huge award, man. And when you actually got selected, I dove into just the preparation and how you came in the locker room. Like you demanded for one, you demanded the attention, respect, and a work ethic that was so contagious amongst the locker room. Lord used to come in and work out with the young fellas, you know what I am saying? Having us on point, you know what I am saying? Hitting that iron, them sumo squats. I will never forget the sumo squats.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Garnett
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett on Tony Allen's growth and first team selection
quotes.excerpt: When I saw you dab on the floor and you in first team
quotes.quote: Lord, listen, when I saw you dab on the floor and you in first team, I said he went over there, he learned something. This whole time this boy been in here I am thinking he ain't learned nothing. This man went over there, he learned something. He thought I was not listening. He thought I was not listening. This man went over there and learned something.

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Allen on Kevin Garnett's leadership and grit
quotes.excerpt: You just got to have grit and balls, baby. Just grit and balls up in here
quotes.quote: He used to come in the locker room, we would get a big win, we would win, we probably look like we about to lose. He come there late after the interview, you just got to have grit and balls, baby. Just grit and balls up in here, baby.
